body: Several accounts and servers on Android, the local area, copying lists between accounts, the client's protocol floor; the server's no_app_package 404 carries protocol and the landing page's intent link carries the mount path. Protocol stays 3. Release notes in the tag; the floor table's Since set to 3.2.0 in the same pass. Operators: deploy the server first, then update the phone right away.
title: Release 3.2.0
